title: AI at Work: A Simple How To Guide for Using AI in Your Next Negotiation
author: Alexandra Mislin
excerpt_html: AI will not negotiate for you, but it can make you far better prepared. Use it to THINK clearly, get CURIOUS about what the other side needs, and walk in ready to ASK with confidence and flexibility.
